UI design · Service concept

A coffee order, comfortably within reach.

A tabletop ordering concept connecting the physical dining experience with a clear digital flow.

RoleInterface design
ScopeTabletop interaction, menu, order summary, payment
ContextConcept project

The idea

Order from your seat

A self-ordering tablet positioned at the table lets customers place an order without leaving their seats. The concept considers both screen navigation and the physical position of the device.

Physical touchpoints

An interface that meets the customer

The proposed tablet adjusts to a comfortable angle when a button is pressed and rotates to serve people across the table. The physical interaction is part of the service concept, rather than a built or validated hardware product.

Interface flow

From browsing to confirmation

The screens connect a welcome page, product categories, a menu, an order summary, payment selection, and a successful-order confirmation. Orange and pink carry the brand’s familiar visual character through the journey.

Completing the journey

A clear finish to the order

The payment screen presents the available methods, followed by an order confirmation. These final touchpoints help communicate what happens next after a customer has selected their items.

Outcome

What the work brings together.

A connected set of interface concepts for tabletop ordering. The portfolio documents the proposed device interaction and screen flow; it does not report a deployed system or measured usability results.
